Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That’s it from the coverage of this game. The hosts have taken a 1-nil lead in this three-match series. But let us not forget, India took the lead in the Test series but South Africa turned it around in the next two games. India would hope they can replicate the same in this series and would look to come back stronger in the second ODI. This game will be played on 21st with the first ball being bowled at 1400 IST (0830 GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Cheers!

Rassie van der Dussen wins the Man of the Match award for his incredible knock with his blade. He says, he knew he needed to go for the sweeps and reverse sweeps and put the spinners under pressure. Adds as soon as they got a partnership going on a good batting wicket, they put up a good score. Adds there was pressure when he walked out but he was confident and the team was confident and they knew 285 plus was going to be a good score and all in all, it was a good day for them. Ends by saying when Shikhar and Kohli were there, they were under pressure but as soon as they got those wickets, the game changed and they knew if they kept taking wickets, they will build pressure.

Temba Bavuma, the victorious skipper is in for a chat. He says it was a good win and he is happy. States he struggled throughout the innings to hit it in the middle and find the gaps but Rassie did really well and he provided the much-needed impetus and he just wanted to hang in there with him. Credits Jansen for the way he bowled and says he is growing as a cricketer. Mentions Markram is always an option for them with the ball and he always comes in handy. Further says Andile was really good, he would have loved to play a bigger part in the game but he understood the situation and he is a big player in the team and he rose to the occasion. Ends by saying the spinners were excellent, they tried to use Shamsi differently and he did really well and he is also pleased to have de Kock back and he is a big player for the team.

KL Rahul, the Indian skipper is in for a chat. He says it was a good game and they love playing in such games, there is a lot to learn. Admits they struggled to get wickets in the middle and they need to work on that. Further adds they were on par with the bat till the 25th over but then South Africa bowled really well. Mentions he did not bat for long so he has no idea about how much the pitch changed but Virat and Dhawan did tell him it was a good wicket to bat on, you just needed to hang in there. Also says when two people from the opposition bat deep, they are bond to post a good score, they needed someone to do that but that was not the case. Ends by saying they did feel in the break they gave away 30 runs extra but had they got a few more partnerships, they could have gotten over the line and they will learn from this.
Stay tuned for presentation...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, South Africa were in trouble as they were three down in for less than 100. Then came the 200-run stand between Rassie van der Dussen and Temba Bavuma with both scoring runs and that powered the hosts close to 300. India began well, for the first part of the second essay, it seemed India would take the lead in this series but in the end, it is the home side who head into the second ODI with the advantage.

For South Africa, they did not bowl that well in the first half of this innings! There were far too many boundary balls, they struggled to build pressure on the Indian batters and also bowled quite a few extras. Not their fault too, the ball seemed to be coming on very nicely. Once the ball got old and soft though, it started to grip and then the likes of Shamsi and Maharaj came into their own. Ngidi was also very handful with his cutters and Andile Phehlukwayo also did his job. A really good effort from them after being put under pressure.

A very convincing win in the end for South Africa! Never did we feel though it would be that convincing. The top three really played well to get India into a fine position. Especially Kohli and Dhawan. The two added just over 90 and scored half tons each. However, the two fell in quick succession and then it all went down the hill for India. The likes of Pant and the two Iyers failed to contribute a lot. It then became an uphill task and they fell short by some margin.

FIFTY for Thakur but he ends up on the losing side. Something to cheer about for India at the end of the game. Full length, outside off. Thakur lofts it over covers for a single. Bumrah walks across and hugs Thakur. SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE GAME BY 31 RUNS.
Fuller, wide outside off. Bumrah taps it to point for a single.
Full and outside off. Thakur hits it down the ground for a single.
Full and wide outside off. Bumrah steers it to third man for one.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off. Bumrah looks to reach out but fails to get any bat on it. Although, it is outside the tramline and the umpire signals it as a wide. The bowler has to reload.
Full and wide outside off. Bumrah looks to chase it but misses.
Fuller, wide outside off. Thakur drives it through cover for one.
A dot to end the over. A brilliant penultimate over by Tabraiz Shamsi. Full and on off. Bumrah defends it out. Shamsi kept things quiet and gave away only 5 runs.
Full and on leg. Thakur gets low and sweeps it to mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on middle. Bumrah works it to deep square leg and gets a single.
Angled down leg. Thakur swivels and pulls it to fine leg for a run.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Bumrah sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Googly, on middle, Thakur gets it to the leg side off the inside edge. They take a single.
Full and outside off. Thakur slaps it through covers for a single.
SIX! BANG! Three boundaries in a row and this is much better. Full length, on off. Thakur stays back and smokes it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. This time he gets lucky though. Full and outside off. Thakur gets it off the outside edge and bags a boundary at third man.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full length, wide outside off. Thakur reaches out and crunches it through covers for a boundary.
Full and outside off. Bumrah reaches out and lofts it towards long off for a run.
Good length, on off. Thakur hangs back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off. Thakur drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
Full and on off. Thakur sweeps it to deep square leg for a couple.
On off, defended out.

Flighted, full and on leg. Bumrah tucks it to mid-wicket. Thakur wanted a single but Bumrah was not convinced, he started his run up late. The fielder misses his shy at the non-striker's end but misses, which gives Bumrah time to get back. The throw comes in again and connects this time but it was a little to late. The replays confirm that Bumrah was in.
TWO BYES! Full and outside off. Bumrah throws his bat at it but misses. The ball goes through the legs of Quinton de Kock. They collect two byes.
Full and on leg. Thakur slogs it away to deep square leg for a run.
On off, Bumrah strokes it towards deep cover.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Fuller and on off, this is hit hard but to mid off.
Angled into the pads, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! India need a lot more! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled, it goes over short fine leg for a boundary.
Shorter and down the leg side, Thakur pulls it fine, two taken.
Tossed up on middle, Thakur swings, it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, this is swept fine on the leg side for two.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Slower through the air, on the pads, Bumrah looks to sweep but misses.
On middle, this is played down to long on for one.
Bumrah plays the over out! On middle, he defends.
Two more! Fuller and on middle, this is pushed wide of mid on, Ngidi dives and stops it. Two taken.
Swing and a miss! Shorter and outside off, Bumrah looks to go big on the leg side but misses it completely.
On middle, Bumrah plays it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, Bumrah looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
Shorter and on middle, Thakur pulls it through square leg for one.
On middle, defended.
Yet another dot! On middle, kept out.
Flatter and on off, Bumrah defends.
Outside off, it is left alone.
On middle, Bumrah plays it to mid-wicket.
Jasprit Bumrah is the new man in.

OUT! Straight to the man! This time no mistake was commited. Bavuma is the catcher and Shamsi gets another one. On middle, this is flicked uppishly but straight into the hands of Bavuma. Soft dismissal.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: On the pds, Kumar looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Fuller and on off, this is driven square to point.
Angled into the pads, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
PUT DOWN! That is a dolly! Can't believe Miller has spilled that! He is such a safe fielder! A slower one, Kumar chips it towards him at cover but he spills it.
Fuller and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Short and on middle, that gets big on the batter. Thakur looks to nudge it on the leg side but it goes off a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
Good length and on off, this is played to point for one.
Swing and a miss! A full-length ball, outside off. Thakur looks to chase it but misses.
Angled into the pads, blocked to the leg side.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. This is beautifully played. Overpitched. outside off. Thakur creams it through covers for a boundary.
Length and on middle. Thakur pushes it to mid on off the inner half.
Full and on off. Thakur pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Nicely played. Full, drifting down leg. Thakur glances it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Two dots to end the over! A brilliant over by Lungi Ngidi, just three runs off it. Full and outside off. Kumar taps it to point.
Off-pace, full-length delivery, outside off. Kumar defends it out watchfully.
Short and outside off. Thakur cuts it through point for a single.
BEATEN! Full-length ball, outside off. Thakur reaches out but fails to get any blade on it.
Fuller, on off. Thakur pushes it back to the bowler with soft hands.
Full length, outside off. Kumar drives it to cover and gets a single.
WIDE! Full and outside the tramline. Kumar leaves it alone. Wide called.
200 up for India. Short and outside off. Kumar cuts it through point for a run.
Fuller, outside off. Kumar pushes it to cover. Not in the gap.
Full, on middle and leg. Kumar strides forward and works it towards mid on.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes in at number 9.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Brilliant from Andile Phehlukwayo, he gets his second wicket of the game. Into the tail-enders now, South Africa are in a hurry to end things here. A full-length ball, on off, it stays low after hitting the deck. Ashwin makes room and looks to push it to the off side but gets an inside edge and sees the ball shatter the stumps behind.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Ashwin slashes it to deep point for just a single.
A dot to end the over! Good length, outside off. Thakur steers it towards backward point. India need 100 runs off 72 balls.
Good length, on the fourth stump line. Ashwin guides it down to third man for a single.
Full and outside off. Ashwin drives it to cover.
Full length, outside off. Ashwin plays it square on the off side.
Full and wide outside off. Thakur throws his bat at it. The ball takes the inside edge and goes to the left of the keeper. Ashwin calls for a single and Thakur gets to the other end safely.
FOUR! Nicely played. Length ball, drifting down leg. Thakur glances it to fine leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Length, wide outside off. Thakur looks to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Good length, outside off. Ashwin punches it to cover. At the same time, South Africa were at 190 as well but had 7 wickets in hand. India need a solid stand to make it a close contest yet again.
Fuller and outside off. Thakur drives it to deep cover for just one.
Good length, on off. Thakur works it to mid-wicket off the inner half.
Full and outside off. Thakur presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Full, on the pads, Ashwin clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
A full-length ball, on off. Ashwin pushes it to mid on.
Length ball, on off. Thakur defends it to cover.
Shardul Thakur is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Venkatesh Iyer tries to break the shackles but holes out instead. A short ball, on off. Iyer stays inside the crease and hooks it towards deep square leg. He does not get the desired distance on it. Rassie van der Dussen takes a sharp catch in the deep. Lungi Ngidi gets his second wicket of the game. South Africa well on top here.
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off. Ashwin taps it to backward point and scampers through for a quick single. Also, Lungi Ngidi gets a warning for landing in the danger zone after his run up.
Full length, outside off. Iyer drives it to cover for a single.
Back of a length, on top of off. Iyer stays back and defends it to point.
Short ball, outside off. Ashwin cuts it to the left of backward point. The fielder there dives to his left to make a half stop. The batters take a single.
On middle, defended.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, defended.
On off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is guided to point.
Ashwin is off the mark! A full toss on middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket, the fielder dives to his right and stops it. Can't stop the single.
Ravichandran Ashwin is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! That is magical work from de Kock! Wow! Probably one of the fastest stumpings we have seen. That is tremendous. This is down the leg side, de Kock is up to the stumps for Andile Phehlukwayo! Pant looks to flick but misses. He drags his back foot out as he tries to flick but misses. De Kock, collects it brilliantly and within no time, takes the bails off. He starts celebrating. It is referred and replays show that Pant is short. Body blow, Pant needed to stay there till the end. Now this target looks far away.
Commentary.Howout: st Quinton de Kock b Andile Phehlukwayo

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a fair stumping? The umpires take it upstairs. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The replays confirm Pant was outside the crease as the bails were coming off. The final decision is not out.
Short and outside off, Iyer lets it go through to the keeper. No carry at all there. This pitch just seems like getting tougher. 116 needed in 96.

DRINKS! With this wicket of Shreyas Iyer, South Africa are well on top here. They would look to keep chipping away wickets and take the game away from the visitors. India on the other hand, need Pant to stick in the middle for long. Venkatesh Iyer joins him in the middle who is making his debut. He had a dream Indian Premier League debut in 2021 and would look to have a similar impact for his country now.

OUT! GLOVED AND TAKEN! Iyer walks back and South Africa now have control over this game. Shreyas was looking at so much ease but now falls! A short one down the leg side, Iyer looks to pull, once again this sticks in the surface. It goes off the glove as Iyer is through his shot. De Kock takes it. An appeal and the finger is raised. Now South Africa are into the all-rounders. India still 116 runs away.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: That has been hammered but only for one! Shorter and on middle, Pant pulls it through square leg for one.
On a good length and on off, Iyer guides it down to third man and takes one. Good sensible batting.
On the pads, Pant works it down to fine leg for one.
Slower one, this is guided down to third man for one.
Lungi Ngidi comes back into the attack now.
Shorter and on middle, Iyer looks to pull, it goes off the inner half through square leg for a single. An expensive start then from Andile.
More runs! Two of them! Outside off, this is carved through point. Two taken.
FOUR! This time he pays the price for bowling a little too straight, on the pads, this is worked behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Andile Phehlukwayo gets away with one there! On the pads, this is flicked but straight to short fine leg. Iyer sets off but is sent back.
Pant has probably decided to go after Andile! This is full and outside off, Pant swings hard, it goes off the inner half on the leg side for one.
Misfield! Very unlike South Africa today! On middle, this is pushed to mid-wicket. The fielder fumbles and a single is taken.
Iyer wanted two but only one! Fuller and outside off, this is driven nicely through covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, Pant pulls it hard through square leg for one.
Full and wide outside off, Pant throws the kitchen sink at it but misses.
Short and on middle, Iyer pulls it down to fine leg for one.
On middle, Pant works it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! There comes the shot which releases a little pressure! Fuller and on middle, easy pickings, it is driven hard down the ground for a boundary.
Brilliant fielding again! Saves three. On the pads, Pant sweeps it hard, Ngidi at short fine leg dives to his left and gets a hand to it. jansen covers up, just the one.

PUT DOWN! Tough chance but you expect Bavuma to take that. He is exceptional. That would have put South Africa in control quite easily. This is tossed up on off, Pant smacks it hard but uppishly towards cover. Bavume dives to his left and gets two hands to it but does not hang on.
This time finds the gap in the square leg region and takes one.
South Africa have their tails up now! On middle, Iyer flicks, the fielder at square leg, moves quickly to his left and saves a run for his side.
That is outstanding fielding! On middle, Pant sweeps it through square leg. Jansen in the deep, runs to his left, slides and keeps it to one.
Outside off, Iyer slaps it through covers for one.
Two dots in a row! This is what South Africa need to do. They need to squeeze now! On middle, Pant works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, Pant works it to mid-wicket.
Soft hands! On off, Iyer plays it down to third man and takes one.
Good length and outside off, Pant guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
This time he finds the gap through covers and takes one.
Slightly fuller and on off, Iyer pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! The pitch has started to play tricks now! This lands on off and then turns away a long way. Pant is beaten as he tries to defend.
Really good stop! Tossed up on off, this one turns away. Pant lunges and tries to block, it goes off the outside edge, the fielder at slip dives to his left and stops it well.
Pant is disappointed but the sweeps are just not hitting the middle at the moment. This one too holds in the surface. Pant is early in the sweep, he mistimes it to backward square leg.
Not the best of deliveries to the new batter! Short and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shreyas Iyer is the new man in.

OUT! Top edge and taken! There is the wicket South Africa needed, the big fish, Virat Kohli, once again fails to covert his start into a big one and have to say, the hosts on top now. Also, the wicket has started to play tricks quite a lot now. This is tossed up, slower and on middle, Kohli who is not a natural sweeper, goes for it, the ball though sticks in the surface, Kohli is through his shot, it goes off the toe-end and it is a simple catch to Bavuma at mid-wicket. Kohli looks down at the surface and righty so, that ball just did not arrive.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, defended.
Another single as this is eased down to long off. End of a decent spell by Maharaj. Was not at his best but did get the big wicket of Dhawan.
On middle, Pant flicks it through square leg for one.

Fifty for Kohli! Yet another one for him. Another excellent knock in a run chase. He probably holds the key for his side. He though will not only want to take his side over the line now but also end his wait for his ton. He gets there by working this through square leg.
On middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Yet another easy run! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Kohli moves onto 49 now! On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one.
WIDE! Yet another wide! Down the leg side. Left alone.
Nice amount of turn again for Shamsi! On off and spins away. Pant plays it back to the bowler.
On middle, Kohli had to get bat on that, he does work it through square leg for one.
They need more dots! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Two more! On middle, this is hit hard down the ground, the fielder at long off runs to his right and keeps it down to two.
Down the leg side, wided. Quite a few wides by Maharaj.

That is frustrating! The last thing they would have wanted after making a few adjustments in the field is an easy single to the new batter. Pant pushes this tossed up ball towards cover and gets to the other end.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, Kohli works it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled, not off the middle, more off the inner half through square leg for one.
Pant steps out, this is tossed up, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Rishabh Pant comes out at number 4.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a rippa of a delivery! Wow! That came from nowhere. First real sign of the ball turning big in this innings. Dhawan and Kohli, both are taken by surprise here. This is shorter in length and outside off, Dhawan shapes himself to cut it, this one turns back in sharply goes under the bat and hits the stumps. Is that the wicket which changes the game? The stand which was taking the game away has been broken. 159 more needed in 147. Dhawan walks back after a fine knock, a good return for him back in the side. He just did not seem like getting out but Maharaj has produced something special.
Dhawan misses out! A full toss outside off, Dhawan hits it hard but to covers.
On middle, tossed up, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Tossed up, slower and outside off, Dhawan looks to sweep but is a touch early in the shot, it goes off toe-end towards mid-wicket. A dot to end but a productive over for India.
On the pads, Kohli works it towards short fine leg for one
Yet another single! On middle, shorter, this is pushed down to long on for one.
That is a safe shot! Kohli comes down the track and then chips it but it lands well short of long on. Only one.
FOUR! Put away nicely! Shorter in length and on the pads, Kohli rocks back and pulls it hard, it goes through square leg for a boundary.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Good sensible batting! This is on middle, Dhawan works it with the turn towards square leg for one.
On off, Kohli pushes it through covers for one.
Shorter and on off, Dhawan pushes it through covers for one.
Well bowled! Floats it up and lands it on off, defended.
Shorter and on middle, Kohli pulls, it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on middle, defended. South Africa need to bowl more dots. There isn't any pressure on the Indian batters at the moment.
Another single as this is flicked down to long on.
On middle, Kohli works sweeps it hard, through mid-wicket for two.
On off, this is pushed to covers for no runs.
Super work in the field yet again! Shorter and outside off, Kohli cuts it hard but the fielder at point dives to his left and makes a half stop. A single in the end.
On off, this is hit down to long off for one. Really good fielding again.
Two more! This is tossed up on middle, it is swept hard towards deep mid-wicket for two.
WIDE! Shamsi has not got it right so far! Down the leg side, wided.

That is brilliant work! Kohli comes down the track and chips it over the bowler's head. The fielder at long on runs to his left, stops it with a dive and as he is falling onto the ground, parries it to the man running to his right from long off. Only one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
On the pads, this is nudged on the leg side for one more.
Well fielded! On middle, this is worked on the leg side, Ngidi at square leg dives to his left and stops one.
This is swept hard but straight to the man at deep mid-wicket.
Outside off, flatter, Dhawan guides it to point.
Full and outside off. Dhawan slashes it through point for a single. An expensive start by Tabraiz Shamsi, 9 runs off his first. Great maneuvering of the ball here.
On off, played back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely played. Floated, full and on leg. Dhawan gets low and looks to sweep it away, it goes off the top-edge and into the boundary at square leg.
Two runs now! Short and outside off. Dhawan hits it to long on against the turn.
Fuller, on middle. Kohli flicks it to the leg side. The fielder there makes a half stop and the batters take a single.
Outside off. Kohli helps it to covers.
WIDE! Tabraiz Shamsi starts with a loosener. Floated, full and down leg. Kohli looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
Short and on leg. Dhawan comes forward and pulls it to short fine leg.
Tosses it up, on middle. Kohli drives it down the ground for a run.
On the pads, flicked to the onside.
Full and on leg. Kohli leans forward and defends it to mid on.
Full and outside off. Dhawan taps it to point for a quick single.
Touch short, on the pads. Dhawan goes back and flicks it to short fine leg.

DRINKS! India are in a really strong position! They are going along well courtesy the pair of Dhawan and Kohli and if they continue to bat the way they are, India should cruise home. South Africa on the other hand, need to break this stand and get into the relatively inexperienced middle order. Can they do it?
Full length, outside off. Kohli leans in and drives it to cover. Not in the gap.
On off, blocked out.
Good length, outside off. Dhawan looks to play it across the line, but is a touch early through his shot, it goes to short third man off the inside edge for a single.
WIDE! A sharp bumber, on middle. Dhawan leaves it alone. The umpire signals a wide due to the height.
Good length, on off. Dhawan defends it to cover.
FOUR! Up and over! Dhawan picks the gap beautifully and brings up 100 for India. Full-length ball, outside off. Dhawan reaches out and loft it over covers for a boundary.
Slightly short and outside off. Dhawan hangs back and cuts it to deep cover for a couple now. He plays this under his eyes and gets it off the middle. He is in fine touch.
Two dots to end the over. This one hurries onto the batter, on leg. Kohli goes back and tucks it to the leg side.
On middle, defended out off the front foot.
Darted on the pads. Dhawan nurdles it to the onside for a quick single.
Third single of the over! Floated, full and on leg. Kohli clips it to deep mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off. Dhawan punches it through point for another run.
On leg, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around off, shaping away from the left-hander. Dhawan leaves it alone.
Full length, outside off. Kohli drives it to deep cover for a single now. This is good batting.
FOUR! What a shot! Full length, on off. Kohli comes down the track and flicks it past mid on for a boundary. Ngidi cannot believe how has he hit that so good.

A sharp bouncer, on the body. Kohli comes forward and looks to pull it away but misses. Kohli has a smile across his face. He thinks this was way above the head but the umpire deems it as a first bouncer.
Full length, outside off. Dhawan stays back and cuts it to deep cover for a run. He gets it off the middle this time.
Good length, in the corridor of uncertainty. Kohli punches it past backward point for a single.
Around off, turning away a bit. Dhawan stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off. Dhawan defends it out watchfully.
Angled down leg. Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full, on middle. Kohli defends it out off the front foot.
On the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a couple this time.
Floated, full, on middle and leg. Kohli defends it into the deck.
Full-length ball, outside off. Dhawan comes down the track and pushes it to cover. Does not find the gap.
Good running! Length ball, on the pads, too straight. Dhawan clips it to deep square leg for a brace.
Indian players happy to keep the runs ticking. Length ball, angled into the pads. Kohli gets inside the line and nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Dhawan punches it through the gap at covers for a run.
On leg, flicked to square leg for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Dhawan steps down the track and punches it to covers for a run.

FIFTY FOR DHAWAN! This has been a good start for Dhawan and gets an applause from the dugout. He will surely be eyeing the three digit figure now. Full and on leg. Dhawan flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
On leg, blocked out.
Tossed up, full and on leg. Kohli drive it down to long on for another single.
Angled into the pad. Dhawan clips it to square leg for a run.
Floated, full and on leg. Kohli clips it to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Kohli pushes it to mid off.
Length ball, on off. Kohli defends it to square leg off the inner half. He gets across for a single. He will retain the strike.
Full-length ball, outside off. Dhawan punches it through point for a single.
Three dots in a row! On a length, on off. Dhawan pushes it to cover. Not in the gap though.
This time it is full, on off. Dhawan stays back and pushes it to mid off.
BEATEN! Nicely bowled. Good length, outside off, shaping away. Dhawan looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full length, on off. Kohli comes across and pushes it to mid off for a single.
FOUR! EDGY! Lucky boundary for Dhawan. Full and outside off. Dhawan hangs his blade out, it goes off the outside edge to third man and into the fence. He moves to 47.
Tosses it up, outside off. Dhawan taps it to point. He was looking for a single but Kohli wisely sends him back.
Full and on off. defends it to the left of the bowler.
Angles in with the arm now. Dhawan prods and looks to defend it out but gets and inisde edge onto the pads.
Full and on leg. Dhawan clips it to mid-wicket for a couple of runs. This is good running.
Floated, full and outside off. Kohli drives it to long off for an easy single.
Full and on off. Kohli pushes it down the ground for a single.
Floated, full and on off. Dhawan gets it to the left of the bowler off the inside edge. They take a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Kohli clips it to mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Kohli leaves it alone. Wide called by the umpire.
Full and on leg. Kohli eases it to mid-wicket.
Full and on off. Kohli leans forward and clips it to mid-wicket.
Tossed it up, on off. Dhawan drives it through covers for an easy one.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of 40th over.
Slows it up and lands it on middle, defended nicely. Good comeback by the bowler then after going for a boundary early on.
On middle, kept out.
Tosses it up on off, defended.
A single now as this is flicked through mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked to the left of the bowler.
FOUR! That is a poor ball to begin with! A total loosener. Short and down the leg side. Dhawan pulls it through fine leg for a boundary.
Keshav Maharaj comes into the attack now. He replaces Marco Jansen.
A dot to end a successful over. On middle, Kohli works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Put away and Kohli is off the mark in style. A gift for him. Short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket and it races away to the fence.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Virat Kohli walks out at number 3 for India.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! There is the big wicket of the Indian skipper and Markram strikes. This is flatter and on off, Rahul plays for the turn. He looks to defend but this goes on with the arm. It takes the outside edge and de Kock takes it. Huge wicket as Rahul is very dangerous once he gets his eye in. Also, like most of the times, it is not the ball that turns but the one that goes on with the arm is what gets you out.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Aiden Markram

Commentary.Commentary: Floated up on off, this is chipped down to long off for one more.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A dot to end but a good over for India. On off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! Up and over. India finding it very easy at the moment. This is shortish and outside off, this is hit over point for a boundary.
On off, this is cut hard, there is a man close in at point who stops it well. He is hurt.
FOUR! Put away! Short and on middle, poor delivery with no fielder in the deep on the leg side. Dhawan pulls it through square leg and it races away to the fence.
Just short. Dhawan steps out. This is banged in short. He looks to slap it over covers but it goes off the splice and lands just short of cover.
Good delivery! Probably the first ball Jansen bowls to Rahul. He squares him up, lands on off and then moves away. It goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
A single to end! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, Dhawan takes one as he eases it to mid on.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

Lucky runs! Tossed up nicely on off, this one turns back in. Rahul looks to go over mid off but he gets an inside edge, it goes past leg stump. An early dive from Shamsi sees the ball go past him at short fine leg. Three taken.
Angled into the pads, Dhawan works it through mid-wicket for one.
Good shot but not good running. Rahul comes down the track and flicks it wide of mid-wicket. Only one.
On off, Dhawan pushes it to covers.
Another dot! On off, defended.
FOUR! That is a poor ball! On the pads, this is flicked nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary. Dhawan is looking really good.
On middle, Dhawan works it to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Swing and a miss! Good length, outside off. Dhawan looks to chase it but misses.
Full, on middle and leg. Rahul flicks it to the leg side. This has been a stable start for India.
A single as this is eased down to long off.
FOUR! Nice use of the feet. Full and on middle. Dhawan advances down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
On leg, worked to square leg.
Full, on middle, blocked back to the bowler.
Full and on leg, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Length, on leg. Dhawan tucks it square on the leg side. A good over for India.
Back of a length, on the bodyline. Dhawan swivels and looks to pull it away. The ball brushes the gloves and goes towards fine leg. The batters take two.
Back of a length, on off. Dhawan blocks it back to the bowler.

FOUR! This is a glorious drive! A full-length ball, outside off. Dhawan presses forward and drives it through the cover region for a boundary. He gets his second boundary off Jansen but this time he timed it to perfection.
Fuller, on the pads. Dhawan clips it to deep square leg. The fielder takes some time to get to the ball and the batters run two easily.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Dhawan puts his front leg across and defends it to the leg side.
Angled into the pads. Rahul stays back and flicks it to the leg side. Another good over by Aiden Markram.

Flighted, full and on off. Rahul pushes it to mid off for a quick single. The fielder throws the ball towards the keeper. Quinton de Kock fails to keep it in control which allows the batters to take an extra run.
Full and on off. Rahul prods and defends it to mid-wicket.
Quicker and on off. Rahul blocks it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Dhawan drives it down the ground to long off for a run.
Slower through the air, on off. Rahul pushes it to mid off for a single.
Length, on off. Dhawan defends it out solidly.

FOUR! STREAKY! Marco Jansen has his hands on his head. He cannot believe how that missed the stumps. A length ball, angled in on off. Dhawan gets an inside edge, the ball scoots past the stumps and runs down to the fine leg fence.
Short ball, outside off. Dhawan hangs back and cuts it towards point. Aiden Markram flies to his right and gathers the ball. That is some stop.
Make that three! Full length, on middle and leg. Dhawan defends it to the onside.
Two dots in a row! Good length, outside off, Dhawan shuffles across and leaves it alone for the keeper.
Back of a length, outside off. Dhawan stays back and punches it to point.
Marco Jansen to steam in from the other end with the second new ball.
Looped up, on middle. Rahul eases it back to the bowler. Just two runs off it, a tidy start for the spinner.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
Dhawan is off the mark now. Full and on leg. Dhawan clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on middle. Dhawan prods and defends it back to the bowler.
KL Rahul and India are off the mark! Tossed up, full and on leg. Rahul clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
